item.title: An Unusual Route: Why I Chose Full-Time MOOCs Over Traditional Paths in 2016
item.description:
Looking back a decade to 2016, I made a decision that looked to everyone around me like career suicide: fresh out of a Diploma in Business Studies, I walked away from the conventional university conveyor belt and refused to settle into a standard 9-to-5 desk job.

Instead, I locked myself in my bedroom, turned on my monitor, and went all-in on full-time, self-directed learning through Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs).

item.title: At the Peak but Bound by Ground: The Unfinished Journey to the Frontier
item.description: How a self-taught 20-year-old from Malaysia hit #1 on MIT's DeepTraffic leaderboard, caught the eye of NVIDIA and FAANG executives, stepped back for family—and why, now unbound by geography, he is ready for the frontier.

item.title: 300km in 24 Hours - My Malaysia Ultra Solo Ride Record in Casual Gear
item.description: An unsupported 298 km solo ultra-cycling loop across Malaysia in 23h 17m on a DIY gravel bike in casual gear—proving mental grit beats elite equipment.

item.title: Pitch Black Detours and 2,000m+ Climbs: How I Conquered Fraser’s Hill Solo
item.description: A 20-hour, 200km solo gravel ride through pitch-black forest detours, surprise livestock encounters, pro paceline drafts, and 2,208m of climbing to Fraser's Hill—the foundational crucible that paved the way for my 300km graduation challenge.

item.title: The Hardest Online Course I Ever Took
item.description: A personal memoir on conquering the Udacity Self-Driving Car Engineer Nanodegree (SDCND) from scratch without a Computer Science degree—covering MIT DeepTraffic, sensor fusion in C++, and master's-level engineering rigor.

item.title: Looking Back at My 2021 Tech Predictions: How the Future Arrived Right on Schedule
item.description: How accurate were tech predictions from 2021? Author Ng Fang Kiang reviews five years of rapid progress in AI, automation, spatial computing, and hardware, proving that the future arrived right on schedule.

item.title: My Journey with MIT DeepTraffic: Ranking #1
item.description: Read how NG FANG KIANG achieved rank #1 in MIT’s 6.S094 DeepTraffic competition using Deep Reinforcement Learning, leading to a Udacity Self-Driving Car scholarship and high-profile industry recognition.

item.title: That Time NVIDIA AI Followed 135 Accounts on Instagram - And I Was One of Them
item.description: Discover the surreal connection between a self-taught AI enthusiast and NVIDIA AI. Explore how achieving the #1 global spot in MIT’s DeepTraffic and a Udacity SDCND scholarship caught the attention of a tech giant.
